arxiv-2010-00387.title: Incorporating network based protein complex discovery into automated model construction
arxiv-2010-00387.creator: Paul Scherer, Maja Trȩbacz, Nikola Simidjievski
arxiv-2010-00387.description: Abstract We propose a method for gene expression based analysis of cancer phenotypes incorporating network biology knowledge through unsupervised construction of computational graphs. The structural construction of the computational graphs is driven by the use of topological clustering algorithms on protein-protein networks which incorporate inductive biases stemming from network biology research in protein complex discovery.

arxiv-2107-01604.title: Deterministic and Probabilistic Error Bounds for Floating Point Summation Algorithms Thanks: This research was supported in part by the National Science Foundation through grant DMS-1745654 and DMS-1760374.
arxiv-2107-01604.creator: Eric Hallman, Ilse C.F. Ipsen
arxiv-2107-01604.description: Abstract We analyse the forward error in the floating point summation of real numbers, from algorithms that do not require recourse to higher precision or better hardware. We derive informative explicit expressions, and new deterministic and probabilistic bounds for errors in three classes of algorithms: general summation, shifted general summation, and compensated (sequential) summation.

arxiv-2210-01139.title: On the EFT of Conformal Symmetry Breaking
arxiv-2210-01139.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by . Conformal symmetry can be spontaneously broken due to the presence of a defect or other background, which gives a symmetry-breaking vacuum expectation value (VEV) to some scalar operators. We study the effective field theory of fluctuations around these backgrounds, showing that it organizes as an expansion in powers of the inverse of the VEV, and computing some of the leading corrections.

arxiv-2304-09191.title: Sample Variance in Cosmological Observations with a Narrow Field-of-View
arxiv-2304-09191.creator: Peter Espenshade, Jaiyul Yoo
arxiv-2304-09191.description: Abstract Surveys with a narrow field-of-view can play an important role in probing cosmology, but inferences from these surveys suffer from large sample variance, arising from random fluctuations around the cosmic mean. The standard method for computing the sample variance is based on two key approximations: treating perturbations linearly and the survey geometry as a box.

arxiv-2305-16947.title: Sentence-Incremental Neural Coreference Resolution
arxiv-2305-16947.creator: Matt Grenander, Shay B. Cohen, Mark Steedman
arxiv-2305-16947.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Matt Grenander, Shay B. Cohen, Mark Steedman. We propose a sentence-incremental neural coreference resolution system which incrementally builds clusters after marking mention boundaries in a shift-reduce method. The system is aimed at bridging two recent approaches at coreference resolution: (1) state-of-the-art non-incremental models that incur quadratic complexity in document length with high computational cost, and (2) memory network-based models which operate incrementally but do not generalize beyond pronouns.

arxiv-2308-14852.title: SynthDistill: Face Recognition with Knowledge Distillation from Synthetic Data
arxiv-2308-14852.creator: Hatef Otroshi Shahreza, Anjith George, Sébastien Marcel
arxiv-2308-14852.description: Abstract State-of-the-art face recognition networks are often computationally expensive and cannot be used for mobile applications. Training lightweight face recognition models also requires large identity-labeled datasets. Meanwhile, there are privacy and ethical concerns with collecting and using large face recognition datasets.

arxiv-2407-20367.title: Mixed Newton Method for Optimization in Complex Spaces
arxiv-2407-20367.creator: Nikita Yudin, Roland Hildebrand, Sergey Bakhurin, Alexander Degtyarev, Anna Lisachenko, Ilya Kuruzov, Andrei Semenov, Mohammad Alkousa
arxiv-2407-20367.description: Abstract In this paper, we modify and apply the recently introduced Mixed Newton Method, which is originally designed for minimizing real-valued functions of complex variables, to the minimization of real-valued functions of real variables by extending the functions to complex space.

arxiv-2505-04546.title: Algorithms for zero-sum stochastic games with the risk-sensitive average criterion This work was supported by the National Key Research and Development Program of China (2022YFA1004600)
arxiv-2505-04546.creator: Fang Chen, Xianping Guo, Xin Guo, Junyu Zhang
arxiv-2505-04546.description: Abstract Abstract: This paper is an attempt to compute the value and saddle points of zero-sum risk-sensitive average stochastic games. For the average games with finite states and actions, we first introduce the so-called irreducibility coefficient and then establish its equivalence to the irreducibility condition.

pmc-11461436.title: Spotting missing or wanted people: racial biases in prospective person memory
pmc-11461436.creator: Megan H. Papesh, Daniella K. Cash, Juan D. Guevara Pinto, Sofia V. Lomba
pmc-11461436.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Searching for missing or wanted people is a crucial task in our society. Previous work on prospective person memory (PPM) has demonstrated that performance on this type of search task is worse relative to standard prospective memory tasks. Importantly, this process may be further affected by the race of the missing person, yet this has never been tested in laboratory settings.

pmc-11511072.title: Advancements in Ocular Therapy: A Review of Emerging Drug Delivery Approaches and Pharmaceutical Technologies
pmc-11511072.creator: Bhupendra Raj Giri, Deeksha Jakka, Michael A. Sandoval, Vineet R. Kulkarni, Quanying Bao
pmc-11511072.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Eye disorders affect a substantial portion of the global population, yet the availability of efficacious ophthalmic drug products remains limited. This can be partly ascribed to a number of factors: (1) inadequate understanding of physiological barriers, treatment strategies, drug and polymer properties, and delivery systems; (2) challenges in effectively delivering drugs to the anterior and posterior segments of the eye due to anatomical and physiological constraints; and (3) manufacturing and regulatory hurdles in ocular drug product development.

pmc-11606961.title: Study on the coupling coordination and barrier factors between agroecological security and rural green development in China
pmc-11606961.creator: Dandan Gao
pmc-11606961.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Agroecological security is an important part of ecological security. Exploring the coupled and coordinated relationship between agroecological security and rural green development is of great strategic importance for sustainable economic and social development. This study takes 31 provinces (autonomous regions and municipalities directly under the central government) in China from 2011 to 2021 as the research object and constructs an index system of agroecological security and rural green development.

pmc-11637846.title: Isolation of Heavy Metal-Tolerant and Anti-Phytopathogenic Plant Growth-Promoting Bacteria from Soils
pmc-11637846.creator: Soo Yeon Lee, Kyung-Suk Cho
pmc-11637846.description: In this study, multifunctional soil bacteria, which can promote plant development, resist heavy metals, exhibit anti-phytopathogenic action against plant diseaes, and produce extracellular enzymes, were isolated to improve the effectiveness of phytoremediation techniques. In order to isolate multifunctional soil bacteria, a variety of soil samples with diverse characteristics were used as sources for isolation.

pmc-12409587.title: Design of Cu/Zr Alloy Interface for Enhanced Thermal Fatigue Performance in Electronic Packaging
pmc-12409587.creator: John B. Ferguson, Sushil R. Kanel, John G. Jones, Sergei V. Shenogin, Sangwook Sihn, Krishnamurthy Mahalingam, Robert A. Wheeler, Cynthia T. Bowers, Md Sherajul Islam, Ajit K. Roy
pmc-12409587.description: This study addresses a critical limitation in direct bonded copper (DBC) materials used in power electronics by introducing a copper–zirconium (Cu/Zr) alloy interposing layer at the copper-ceramic interface. This novel design aims to mitigate mechanical stress induced by mismatched material properties, such as the coefficient of thermal expansion (CTE) and elastic modulus, during thermal cycling.

pmc-12468230.title: ACT-ON-DIP: Study Protocol of a Randomized Controlled Trial of a Home-Based ACTion Observation Tele-RehabilitatioN for Upper Limb in Children with DIPlegic Cerebral Palsy
pmc-12468230.creator: Elena Beani, Elisa Matteucci, Elisa Sicola, Giada Martini, Maria Chiara Di Lieto, Clara Bombonato, Valentina Menici, Annalisa Cotardo, Marta Rizzo, Silvia Filogna, Federica Camuncoli, Laura Biagi, Giovanni Cioni, Francesca Fedeli, Chiara Gelmini, Rita Neviani, Olivia Vecchi, Silvia Perazza, Silvia F
pmc-12468230.description: Highlights What are the main findings? This is the first study applying AOT specifically to promote upper-limb skills in children and adolescents with diplegic CP. The study adopts a home-based AOT protocol, supported by remote clinical supervision, which increases accessibility for families and allows for a more intensive and flexible delivery of the intervention.

pmc-12784871.title: Caloric Restriction Enhances Chemotherapy Efficacy and Reshapes Stress Responses in Sarcoma
pmc-12784871.creator: Jorddam Almondes Martins, Irislene Costa Pereira, Thiago Sousa Reinaldo, Dallyla Jennifer Morais de Sousa, Isabelle Vasconcelos Rodrigues, Beatriz de Mello Pereira Rego, Aureliano Machado de Oliveira, Taline Alves Nobre, Athanara Alves de Sousa, João Pedro Alves Damasceno do Lago, Rayran Walter Ramo
pmc-12784871.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Simple SummaryCancer treatments often cause strong side effects and do not always stop tumor growth. Recent research suggests that reducing calorie intake for a short period may help the body respond better to chemotherapy while protecting healthy cells. In this study, it was investigated whether combining caloric restriction with the chemotherapy drug doxorubicin could enhance treatment outcomes in mice with sarcoma.

pmc-12837982.creator: Jie Chen, Zhenzhen Zhang, Siwen Fu, Biyu Wen, Zeming Chen, Xiaochun Wang
pmc-12837982.description: BackgroundInternet gaming disorder (IGD) and anxiety frequently co-occur among young adults and represent an increasing mental health concern in China. Nevertheless, the psychological network underlying this comorbidity and the identification of potential intervention targets remain poorly understood.MethodsWe conducted a cross-sectional study of 605 Chinese university freshmen to investigate the association between internet gaming disorder (IGD), anxiety.

pmc-13230126.title: Case Report: A rare co-occurrence of IgA pemphigus and pyoderma gangrenosum associated with IgA-κ type monoclonal gammopathy of undetermined significance: a 19-year diagnostic and therapeutic journey
pmc-13230126.creator: You Xie, Xinqiao Liu, Juan Wu, Liuqing Chen, Jinbo Chen
pmc-13230126.description: We report a complex case of neutrophilic dermatosis (ND) in a 61-year-old woman with a 19-year history of recurrent, pruritic, and painful vesiculopustular eruptions. Her clinical course was marked by evolving diagnoses, from pustular vasculitis to IgA pemphigus and pyoderma gangrenosum (PG). Concurrent investigations revealed an IgA-κ type monoclonal gammopathy of undetermined significance (MGUS).

pmc-13522599.title: Hyperdimensional in-memory computing with analogue memristive crossbar arrays
pmc-13522599.creator: Yi Huang, Alireza Jaberi Rad, Daniel Belkin, Ning Ge, J. Joshua Yang, Miao Hu, Qiangfei Xia
pmc-13522599.description: Deploying large-scale artificial intelligence models for language processing on edge devices is limited by constraints in computational capacity and energy efficiency. To address this challenge, we present a hardware-algorithm co-design framework that leverages analog in-memory computing and hyperdimensional computing for efficient language identification at the edge.

uslaw-usc-t10-s907a.title: 10 U.S.C. § 907a — Art. 107a. Parole violation
uslaw-usc-t10-s907a.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t10-s907a.description: United States Code, Title 10 (Armed Forces); Part II (Personnel); Chapter 47 (Uniform Code Of Military Justice); Subchapter X (Punitive Articles). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Any person subject to this chapter— (1) who, having been a prisoner as the result of a court-martial conviction or other criminal proceeding, is on parole with conditions; and (2) who violates the conditions of parole.
